Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collisoin in which the patient's vehicle
was struck while turning left. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injury
diagnosed, which is a concussion with post-traumatic headache and intermittent
dizziness. Over the course of sixteen visits, care consisted of graded symptom
management, vestibular and oculomotor exercises, cervical physical therapy, and
periodic neurologic reassessment. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit
frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was gradually discharged
from active therapy. Examination findings include reduced tolerance to visual tracking
and mild balance deficits on tandem testing, which support the clinical diagnosis.
Other components of the neurologic examination, including cranial nerve function,
strength, sensation, and coordination, were within normal limits. No prior injury to
the cervical spine or head is documented in the available history. Billing records
reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated
billing observed. Current status is improving, and the patient is expected to reach
maximum medical improvement with continued home eexrcise and symptom monitoring.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
